description: Check if a meeting transcript could have been an email instead. Returns filler word count, decisions made, action items, and a suggested email that would've replaced the meeting.

examples.transcript: Team standup: John reported completion of API integration. Sarah discussed Q4 roadmap priorities. Mike raised concern about database performance. Action: John to share API docs by Friday.

All-hands meeting covering company performance, new benefits rollout, and office reopening policy. HR presented three policy options. Finance reviewed quarterly results. Q&A about remote work flexibility.

name: could_have_been_email_analyze

action_items.description: List of action items from the meeting

could_have_been_email.description: Whether the meeting could have been an email

decisions_made.description: List of decisions made during the meeting

filler_word_count.description: Count of filler words in the transcript

suggested_email.description: Email text that would have replaced the meeting

title: Could Have Been Email Analyze
